title: A Randomized, Controlled, Open-label, Multicenter Clinical Trial Comparing the Efficacy and Safety of a Precision Treatment Regimen Based on Clinical-molecular Phenotypes with a Conventional Treatment Regimen in the Treatment of Patients with Active Takayasu's Arteritis
off: A Randomized, Controlled, Open-label, Multicenter Clinical Trial Comparing the Efficacy and Safety of a Precision Treatment Regimen Based on Clinical-molecular Phenotypes with a Conventional Treatment Regimen in the Treatment of Patients with Active Takayasu's Arteritis
summary: This study aimed to compare the efficacy and safety of a precision treatment regimen based on clinical-molecular phenotypes with a conventional treatment regimen in the treatment of patients with active Takayasu's arteritis based on a randomized, controlled, open-label, multicenter study.

arms.d:
Patients will be given treatment based on their clinical-molecular phenotype according to a predesigned scheme:

1. Patients in constitutional type will be given treatments with GCs combined with TCZ and MTX.
2. Patients in vascular inflammation type without IL-6 and TNF-α elevation will be given treatments with GCs combined with TOF.
3. Patients in vascular inflammation type with IL-6 elevation will be given treatments with GCs combined with TCZ and MTX.
4. Patients in vascular inflammation type with TNF-α elevation will be given treatments with GCs combined with ADA and MTX.
Patients will be given traditional treatment based on their clinical-molecular phenotype according to a predesigned scheme.
